title: Iterated Aluthge transforms of some composition operators on weighted Bergman spaces
summary: In this paper, we compute the iterated Aluthge transforms $\widetilde{C_φ}^{(n)}$ of the composition operator $C_φ$ on the weighted Bergman spaces $\mathcal{A}_α^2(\mathbb{D})$, where $φ(z)=az+(1-a)$ for $0<a<1$. Also, we obtain the norm and numerical radius of $\widetilde{C_φ}^{(n)}$ on $\mathcal{A}_α^2(\mathbb{D})$. We establish that $\widetilde{C_φ}^{(n)}$ converges in the strong operator topology on $\mathcal{A}_α^2(\mathbb{D})$.
